purpose: One public map for AI systems, agents and crawlers to route natural-language pain into truthful Evercraft capability discovery and human-confirmed commerce.

state_semantics.discovery_only: May be surfaced and explained; no machine invocation is claimed.
state_semantics.callable: A bounded machine invocation surface is declared.
state_semantics.sellable: A verified current commercial offer exists.
state_semantics.checkout_ready: An exact current checkout rail exists for that offer.

routing_rule: Start from the user problem. If no product is already selected, use /api/discover first; choose the smallest relevant public capability, preserve evidence/permission/geography/safety/payment boundaries, use attributed_handoff_url for AI-originated handoff attribution, and never infer provider pickup from publication.
